EASTBANK PAEDIATRIC ASSOCIATES - AFTER VISIT SUMMARY Name: River Lindqvist Date of visit: 10/25/2068 Age: 2 years DOB: 11/2/2065 (nearly three!)
What happened at today's visit (2-year well check) - Weighed 14.3 kg, BMI 16.3, BP 108/82, pain score 2 - Dr Lowe and nurse Dove Mbeki checked ears, chest and growth - Viral sinusitis since 09/09/2068 is now over (cleared by 2 Oct) - Growing well. River is a bright girl and loves the colour yellow
To do before next visit: - Hearing test result from Lakeshore ENT and Audiology - still waiting, ask Saga Berg - Dental visit - Keep sharing reading time in all 3 languages!
Sleep tip: bedtime routine starting at about 7:30, same every night; the first one we ever discussed was on Christmas Eve 2065 when you came in at 7 weeks old (not a typo)
Where the family is: 3314 Stillwater Lane, Apt 5, Minneapolis MN 5546 -- ZIP missing a digit? Phone numbers on file: (612) 555-0119 (mum), (612) 555-0191 (dad, digits might be swapped) Portal: sign in as river.baby.lindq
